reason: The claimed hazard does not exist: None is falsy, so both idioms the finding names read an unknown id the same way. 'if not is_read_only(t)' treats it as mutating, and 'if is_read_only(t)' treats it as not read-only; both fail closed (the tool is stripped from a read-intent belt). Only an unnatural 'is not False' check would fail open. The sole mutation-gate caller uses 'is True', and timeout_for is only called for registered ids, where SC-006 parity guarantees a catalog entry.
evidence_checked: Opened the three helpers and grepped every caller in services/routers/models/app.py/main.py (agent_runtime.py:616, :1303 and catalog.py:1589 only).
repro_check: grep -rn 'is_read_only(\|domain_of(\|timeout_for(' sidecar/services -> 3 call sites, all fail-closed or guarded by is_registered.
